scope: Provenance collection only; existing immutable preparation results reused; no dataset/cache/body hash or model/test rerun

initial_offline_check.data_loading_scope: All three official splits loaded, row counts and canonical row digests matched before the later tokenizer assertion
initial_offline_check.failure_scope: Validation script incorrectly expected list[int] from apply_chat_template(tokenize=True) with default return_dict=True

tokenizer_resolution.correction: Explicit return_dict=False when the checker requires list[int]
tokenizer_resolution.verification: Two official first-question inputs: list[int], direct encoding equality and exact rendered-text decoding; no full dataset reload/model/inference/scoring

later_api_contract.scope: Real lm_eval 0.4.13 constructors, CLI/YAML and API payload contract. This is additional API evidence; the explicit tokenizer return_dict=False correction is evidenced by 96741e4c4062 above.

canonical_rows_format.order: Original dataset row order. For complete lm_eval outputs: deduplicate filter copies, validate equal doc objects, order integer doc_id 0..count-1, then use each row[doc].
canonical_rows_format.serialization: json.dumps(doc, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)).encode(utf-8), followed by byte 0x0a after EVERY row including the last
canonical_rows_format.exclude: Do not hash the sample envelope, doc_id/filter/response/metric fields or official doc_hash string; do not strip/normalize source document strings.
canonical_rows_format.train_limit: GSM8K train digest cannot be reconstructed from test-sample doc objects; reuse the established preparation check for train.
